scope: Software, numerical controls, browser behavior and educational source correspondence; not biological, clinical or human-learning validation.

checks: local import and export round trip
automated WCAG A/AA checks with axe
offline single-file operation without HTTP requests
browser_suite.limits: Mobile emulation is not physical-device testing; automated accessibility checks do not certify all accessibility requirements.

scientific_review.envelope_plotting_issue: Fixed by using analytic cone intersections and zero crossings, with an off-grid cusp regression test.
scientific_review.translation_rounding: Detected lost additions and lifetime distortion are checked against the supplied allowance; this is not a complete real-arithmetic certificate.

source_disclosure: No raw model maps, per-site genomic diagrams, variant records, credentials or local machine paths are packaged.
